recipes.name: Jalapeño Popper Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients_raw: 10 pickled jalapeno pepper slices, or to taste - chopped

steps.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and pickled jalapeno in a small bowl. Set aside. Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Slice each roll in half horizontally, then slice the rounded tops off the ciabatta rolls to make a flat top half. Spread 1 teaspoon butter on the doughy cut side of the bottom bun and 1 teaspoon butter on the now flattened top bun. Place 1/2 of the cream cheese mixture, 1/2 of the crushed chips, and 1/2 of the shredded cheese on the non-buttered side of the bottom bun. Place the top half of the bun on the sandwich and place the sandwich on the hot skillet. Repeat with the second sandwich.
Grill until lightly browned and flip over, about 3 to 5 minutes; continue grilling until cheese is melted and the second side is golden brown.

raw_recipe.headline: Jalapeño Popper Grilled Cheese Sandwich
raw_recipe.description: This jalapeño popper grilled cheese combines a spicy cream cheese spread, cheese, and tortilla chips for a grown up version of the classic grilled cheese sandwich.

review.reviewBody: I actually woke up this morning determined to have this for breakfast (I'm pregnant, so it's ok, lol)! I had everything on hand except for the ciabatta rolls, so I just used sliced Italian bread, and that seemed to work out wonderfully. I just eye-balled everything to my taste. I have to say that this really DID taste like a jalapeno popper...SO GOOD! I can't wait to make this for my husband, I know he will LOVE it too. Thanks for sharing this fun, creative and delicious sandwich, that I will be making often~YUM! :)

We loved the flavor of this sandwich, but the texture of the crushed tortilla chips got very soft while cooking. The next time, I would make the sandwich and when it is done, open the sandwich and add the chips so that they would stay crunchy. We tried two different grill cheeses tonight and split them. Also had grilled Romaine, 'Greek Grilled Cheese' and 'Rob's Screaming Stuffed Jalapeño Poppers' from AR.

This was delicious! I have to say that I mixed everything together, cream cheese, sour cream, shredded cheese, crushed chips in a bowl to make it easier to assemble for the family. I then let them add the amt of jalapenos they wanted before cooking. I used plain white bread. They were a hit!

Awesome recipe. I used round bolillo rolls (the kind used in Mexican tortas). To make this a little healthier, I used Greek yogurt in place of sour cream and low fat cream cheese (Neufchâtel). For the chips I subbed fat free crushed pretzels. Tasted just like a popper and my husband loved it. I did add twice as many jalapeños because we are jalapeño lovers.

Excellent sandwiches! I could only find small Ciabatta buns, so I just made 6 small sandwiches instead of 2 big ones. Also accidentally bought garden veggie flavored cream cheese and didn't have sour cream, so used plain Greek yogurt. They were delicious and got a thumbs up from my hubby as well.

Saw this recipe last week and thought my husband would go bonkers over it -and he did. He almost ate the other half of MY sandwich! I used muenster and colby jack on my sandwich, and I used sliced cheese, along with a really good quality sliced sourdough bread on both sandwiches. Here in Texas, there’s a little chill in the air after a long, HOT summer, so I made a pot of homemade tomato soup (of course!) to go along with it, which was the perfect addition. Love the creativity and versatility of this recipe!

I tweak this all over the place - what's new ;) I made the filling with 8 oz cream cheese, a drained 4 oz can of diced jalapenos [not pickled], ~1 cup grated mozzarella, ~1/2 cup grated cheddar jack, and ~1/4 cup bacon bits. I used squaw bread [remind me not to use dark bread for grilled cheese! hard to tell when it's browned - when it starts out brown!], and served it with strawberry jelly. Num num! Though I need to cut the jalapenos back by about 1/2 next time {= Mom liked this - but I picked some of the jalapenos off hers before grilling - so her face did not melt off (=

My boyfriend and I have decided to find "the best grilled cheese" this summer, and this is a definite contender! We used Doritos instead of plain tortilla chips (he used the spicy nacho, I used the original nacho), and we made a fantastic buttermilk ranch dipping sauce to go along with the sandwich. 
If you're making this for more than 2 moderately hungry people, I would definitely double the recipe. Also, if you can only find a loaf of ciabatta bread (as opposed to rolls), just slice it in half horizontally and make rolls that way. The bread definitely makes the sandwich!

Really felt that you needed a grill press to make these. The pan just didn't do it justice because with the thick ciabatta bread it didn't properly melt the insides. I switched chopped red peppers for the jalapenos.

These were great! I skipped the sour cream (did not have any on hand) and just heated the cream cheese a little to make it easier to spread. I also used sliced sourdough bread instead of ciabatta so I wouldn't have to prepare the bread. The chips were soggy by the time I got to my second half so I might skip them next time - but they were good while crunchy! Overall loved the recipe and will make it again.

My girlfriend and I made this two times, the first time we made it by the recipe, and the second time we added in some tomatos and green bell peppers. It was about one tomato, diced and one bell pepper. Also, if you just make the mix for the sandwich, it makes a great chip dip.

Really tasteless. I used high quality cheeses and followed the recipe exactly. Everything worked as described but the result was an otherwise super bland, spicy-hot sandwich. The only take away was slicing the tops off ciabatta rolls before grilled produces a nice result. What a waste of good ingredients.
This sandwich has been a hit with my family for years, and they are picky eaters. We just use regular sandwich bread and leave out the chips.
I make this for my son and I both it is delicious
This was great. No notes.
OMGNESSS!!! This recipe slays, and my hubby loved it. I would totes recommend this, and I give it a fabulous out of ten!

Tried this for lunch today and loved it. I think I used a little too much cream cheese, but I was eyeballing it. I also subbed bacon bits for the crushed tortilla chips, as the bread was plenty of crunch for me.
Not what I thought it would be, didn't care for the pickled jalapenos, too much bread and didn't care for the crushed tortilla chips.

We really, really liked this!! Made using sliced sourdough vs ciabatta and used sliced pepper Jack vs shredded (less mess). I was skeptical about the chili cheese Fritos but they added a nice texture. A fun, delicious Friday night meal. Thank you!
This is amazing! My husband is asking for it again just a few nights after I made it! It was so tasty and flavorful. Even good the next day cold when he took leftovers to work. New family favorite!
